C1302.title: Trivy Security Scanner GitHub Actions Compromised, 75 Tags Hijacked
C1302.summary: Attackers force-pushed 75 version tags in the aquasecurity/trivy-action repository to deliver malware capable of stealing CI/CD sensitive secrets, putting those secrets at risk of theft. The incident shows that if GitHub Actions tags, release processes, and CI/CD credentials are controlled by attackers, they can quickly become supply-chain attack entry points in downstream build pipelines.
